quizTitle: The Dark Side of Business: Shocking Scandals and Lies

questions.question: Enron traders once joked about ‘stealing from Grandma Millie’ while manipulating California’s power supply.
questions.answer: True - Recordings revealed Enron traders laughing about causing blackouts and exploiting ordinary people.

questions.question: Theranos promised to run hundreds of medical tests on a single drop of blood. How many tests could their machine actually perform accurately?
questions.answer: Only a few basic tests - Most results were fake or done on standard lab machines instead of Theranos’s device.

questions.question: Which CEO once told staff to ‘find the gray area and live there’ — later ending up in prison for massive fraud?
questions.answer: Jeff Skilling (Enron) - His culture of pushing limits encouraged unethical risk-taking across the company.

questions.question: How much investor money did Bernie Madoff’s Ponzi scheme steal?
questions.answer: Roughly $65 billion - It was the largest financial fraud in U.S. history, collapsing in 2008.

questions.question: Which company secretly installed software in 11 million cars to cheat emissions tests?
questions.answer: Volkswagen - The ‘Dieselgate’ scandal cost the company over $30 billion in fines and destroyed public trust.

questions.question: When Enron collapsed, how many employees lost their jobs and pensions overnight?
questions.answer: More than 20,000 - Many lost their retirement savings because it was tied to Enron stock.

questions.question: Which luxury brand destroyed millions of dollars worth of unsold clothes to protect its 'exclusivity'?
questions.answer: Burberry - In 2018, it burned unsold products to avoid discounting, sparking public outrage.

questions.question: Which cryptocurrency exchange’s founder was convicted after billions of customer funds vanished?
questions.answer: FTX - Sam Bankman-Fried’s empire collapsed in 2022 after massive fraud and misuse of investor funds.

questions.question: In the Wells Fargo scandal, employees created fake bank accounts to meet unrealistic sales targets. How many fake accounts were discovered?
questions.answer: Roughly 3.5 million - The scandal revealed a toxic culture of pressure and false performance metrics.

questions.question: Which company’s CEO was nicknamed ‘Pharma Bro’ after hiking the price of a life-saving drug by 5,000%?
questions.answer: Turing Pharmaceuticals - Martin Shkreli became a symbol of corporate greed after raising a $13.50 drug to $750 per pill.

questions.question: How many people were convicted after the Enron scandal?
questions.answer: About 30 - Dozens of executives and traders faced charges, though many received light sentences.

questions.question: Which multinational was caught paying millions in bribes to secure contracts in Brazil, leading to a political crisis?
questions.answer: Odebrecht - The scandal, known as ‘Operation Car Wash,’ exposed massive corruption across Latin America.

questions.question: What percentage of global GDP is estimated to be lost to corruption each year, according to the World Economic Forum?
questions.answer: 5% - Corruption drains an estimated $2.6 trillion from the global economy annually.

questions.question: Which company was caught secretly selling user data to political firms like Cambridge Analytica?
questions.answer: Facebook - The 2018 scandal revealed data misuse that affected elections worldwide.

questions.question: When Volkswagen’s Dieselgate scandal broke, how much did their stock value drop in two days?
questions.answer: 30% - Investors panicked as the company’s reputation and profits evaporated almost overnight.
